title: Bind the record transfer to the expected Drive record file
evidence: Filed 2026-11-27 from the PR 2226 review. Scope: bind the transfer to the expected record file. US-09 AC65 decides whether the Drive popup reconnect keeps its grant; this lead carries the expected record file id and grant with the pending transfer, across the reload, so the device copy is sent only into that file. Needs the engine path (packages/health-core/src/drive-rest-record.ts, record-transfer.ts). (H427)
